[[image:Maldenmap.png|right|thumb|200px|Map of Malden]]
'''Malden''' is a city in northern [[Altara]].

== Description ==
The houses there are slate-roofed and built of timber or stone and the city it is encircled by a stone wall. The main commerce of the city is wool and mediocre wine. There is a fortress in the northeast corner. The city's water is supplied from a nearby reservoir by means of an aqueduct.

== Shaido occupation ==
The [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] occupied the area for some time, deposing Lady [[Cairen]], burning part of the city, making most of the original residents ''[[gai'shain]]'', driving the remainder away, and establishing a large encampment surrounding the city.

During the [[Battle of Malden]], the Shaido camp at Malden was attacked by [[Perrin Aybara]] and his allies in order to liberate the Shaido captives, including Perrin's wife [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|Faile]], and neutralize the Shaido threat in the region. Perrin's forces exploited the city's aqueduct to introduce [[forkroot]] into Malden's water supply, virtually eliminating the combat effectiveness of the [[channelers]] among [[Sevanna]]'s [[Wise One]]s.
